typedef T_APP_RESULT (*P_FUN_LE_CIG_MGR_CB)(uint8_t cig_id, uint8_t cb_type, void *p_cb_data)

Param cb_type:

Functions

T_GAP_CAUSE cig_mgr_init(uint8_t cig_num, uint8_t cis_num)

Initialize the number of CIG and CIS.

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
    bool cis_flag = true;

    // e.g.  @ref ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR
    T_GAP_CAUSE cause = cig_mgr_init(0, 1);

    le_set_gap_param(GAP_PARAM_CIS_HOST_SUPPORT, sizeof(cis_flag), &cis_flag);
}

备注

This function is used for ISOCH_ROLE_INITIATOR and ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR.

If CIS will be used, GAP_PARAM_CIS_HOST_SUPPORT by calling le_set_gap_param should be configured as true before gap_start_bt_stack is invoked.

gap_register_direct_cb should be invoked to receive ISO Data via msg type BT_DIRECT_MSG_ISO_DATA_IND.

参数:

  • cig_num -- [in] CIG number for ISOCH_ROLE_INITIATOR.

  • cis_num -- [in] CIS number for ISOCH_ROLE_INITIATOR and ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR.

返回值:

  • GAP_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Operation success.

  • Others -- Operation failure.

返回:

Operation result.

T_GAP_CAUSE cig_mgr_setup_data_path(uint16_t cis_conn_handle, uint8_t path_direction, uint8_t path_id, uint8_t codec_id[5], uint32_t controller_delay, uint8_t codec_len, uint8_t *p_codec_data)

Identify and create the isochronous data path for CIS.

If sending request operation is successful, the result of creating isochronous data path will be returned by the callback function registered by ISOCH_ROLE_INITIATOR or the callback function registered by ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR with msg type MSG_CIG_MGR_SETUP_DATA_PATH.

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
    T_GAP_CAUSE cause = cig_mgr_setup_data_path(cis_conn_handle, path_direction, path_id, codec_id, controller_delay, codec_len, p_codec_data);
}

T_APP_RESULT app_isoc_cis_initiator_cig_cb(uint8_t cig_id, uint8_t cb_type, void *p_cb_data)
{
    T_APP_RESULT result = APP_RESULT_SUCCESS;
    T_CIG_MGR_CB_DATA *p_data = (T_CIG_MGR_CB_DATA *)p_cb_data;

    .......
    switch (cb_type)
    {
    case MSG_CIG_MGR_SETUP_DATA_PATH:
        {
            APP_PRINT_INFO5("MSG_CIG_MGR_SETUP_DATA_PATH: cause 0x%x, conn_id %d, cis_conn_handle 0x%x, cig_id 0x%x, cis_id 0x%x",
                            p_data->p_cig_mgr_setup_data_path_rsp->cause,
                            p_data->p_cig_mgr_setup_data_path_rsp->conn_id,
                            p_data->p_cig_mgr_setup_data_path_rsp->cis_conn_handle,
                            p_data->p_cig_mgr_setup_data_path_rsp->cig_id,
                            p_data->p_cig_mgr_setup_data_path_rsp->cis_id);
        }
        break;
    ......
}

T_APP_RESULT app_isoc_cis_acceptor_cb(uint8_t cb_type, void *p_cb_data)
{
    T_APP_RESULT result = APP_RESULT_SUCCESS;
    T_CIG_MGR_CB_DATA *p_data = (T_CIG_MGR_CB_DATA *)p_cb_data;

    .......
    switch (cb_type)
    {
    case MSG_CIG_MGR_SETUP_DATA_PATH:
        {
            APP_PRINT_INFO5("MSG_CIG_MGR_SETUP_DATA_PATH: cause 0x%x, conn_id %d, cis_conn_handle 0x%x, cig_id 0x%x, cis_id 0x%x",
                            p_data->p_cig_mgr_setup_data_path_rsp->cause,
                            p_data->p_cig_mgr_setup_data_path_rsp->conn_id,
                            p_data->p_cig_mgr_setup_data_path_rsp->cis_conn_handle,
                            p_data->p_cig_mgr_setup_data_path_rsp->cig_id,
                            p_data->p_cig_mgr_setup_data_path_rsp->cis_id);
        }
        break;
    ......
}

备注

This function is used for ISOCH_ROLE_INITIATOR and ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR.

参数:

  • cis_conn_handle -- [in] Connection handle of the CIS.

  • path_direction -- [in] Specify the direction for which the data path is being configured. Value is LE Isochronous Channels Definition Setup Data Path Data Path Direction Flag.

  • path_id -- [in] Specify the data transport path used.

    • 0x00: HCI. DATA_PATH_ID_HCI.

    • 0x01 to 0xFE: Logical_Channel_Number. The meaning of the logical channel is vendor-specific.

  • codec_id -- [in] Specify the coding format used over the air.

    • Octet 0: See Assigned Numbers for Coding Format.

    • Octets 1 to 2: Company ID, see Assigned Numbers for Company Identifier. Shall be ignored if octet 0 is not 0xFF.

    • Octets 3 to 4: Vendor-defined codec ID. Shall be ignored if octet 0 is not 0xFF.

  • controller_delay -- [in] Controller delay in microseconds.

    • Range: 0x000000 to 0x3D0900.

    • Time range: 0 s to 4 s.

  • codec_len -- [in] Length of codec configuration.

  • p_codec_data -- [in] Pointer to codec-specific configuration information for the specified direction.

返回值:

  • GAP_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Sending request operation is successful.

  • Others -- Sending request operation is failed.

返回:

The result of sending request.

T_GAP_CAUSE cig_mgr_disconnect(uint16_t cis_conn_handle, uint8_t reason)

Terminate a CIS connection.

If sending request operation is successful, the response of request will be returned by the callback function registered by ISOCH_ROLE_INITIATOR or the callback function registered by ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR with msg type MSG_CIG_MGR_DISCONNECT.

The notification of disconnection will be returned by the callback function registered by ISOCH_ROLE_INITIATOR or the callback function registered by ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR with msg type MSG_CIG_MGR_DISCONNECT_INFO.

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
    T_GAP_CAUSE cause = cig_mgr_disconnect(cis_conn_handle, reason);
}

T_APP_RESULT app_isoc_cis_initiator_cig_cb(uint8_t cig_id, uint8_t cb_type, void *p_cb_data)
{
    T_APP_RESULT result = APP_RESULT_SUCCESS;
    T_CIG_MGR_CB_DATA *p_data = (T_CIG_MGR_CB_DATA *)p_cb_data;

    .......
    switch (cb_type)
    {
    case MSG_CIG_MGR_DISCONNECT:
        {

备注

This function is used for ISOCH_ROLE_INITIATOR and ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR.

When CIS connection is disconnected with msg type MSG_CIG_MGR_DISCONNECT_INFO :

  • If role is ISOCH_ROLE_INITIATOR for specified CIS, the handle and the associated data paths of that CIS shall remain valid.

  • If role is ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR for specified CIS, the handle and the associated data path of that CIS will be deleted.

参数:

  • cis_conn_handle -- [in] Connection handle of the CIS.

  • reason -- [in] Indicate the reason for ending the connection. 0x05, 0x13 to 0x15, 0x1A, 0x29, 0x3B in Bluetooth HCI Error Code.

返回值:

  • GAP_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Sending request operation is successful.

  • Others -- Sending request operation is failed.

返回:

The result of sending request.

    cause = cig_mgr_set_cig_param(cig_id, &cig_param);

}

        {

            APP_PRINT_INFO4("MSG_CIG_MGR_CIS_REQUEST_IND: conn_id %d, cis_conn_handle 0x%x, cig_id 0x%x, cis_id 0x%x",

                            p_data->p_cig_mgr_reject_cis_info->cis_id);
        }
        break;
    ......
}

备注

This function is used for ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR.

Msg type MSG_CIG_MGR_CIS_REQUEST_IND indicates that the Controller has received a request to establish a CIS.

Meaning for the return value of MSG_CIG_MGR_CIS_REQUEST_IND by application:

  • APP_RESULT_ACCEPT : Inform the Controller to accept the request for the CIS. Result will be notified by msg type MSG_CIG_MGR_ACCEPT_CIS_INFO and MSG_CIG_MGR_CIS_ESTABLISHED_INFO.

  • Neither APP_RESULT_ACCEPT nor APP_RESULT_PENDING : e.g. Bluetooth HCI Error Code (except HCI_SUCCESS), inform the Controller to reject the request for the CIS. Result will be notified by msg type MSG_CIG_MGR_REJECT_CIS_INFO.

  • APP_RESULT_PENDING : Applications should call cig_mgr_acceptor_accept_cis to accept or cig_mgr_acceptor_reject_cis to reject the request for the CIS.

参数:

cb_pfn -- [in] Callback.

Example usage

{
    T_GAP_CAUSE cause = cig_mgr_acceptor_accept_cis(cis_conn_handle);
}

                            p_data->p_cig_mgr_cis_established_info->max_pdu_m_s,
                            p_data->p_cig_mgr_cis_established_info->max_pdu_s_m,
                            p_data->p_cig_mgr_cis_established_info->iso_interval);
        }
        break;
    ......
}

备注

This function is only used after the return value of MSG_CIG_MGR_CIS_REQUEST_IND by application is APP_RESULT_PENDING for ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR.

参数:

cis_conn_handle -- [in] Connection handle of the CIS.

返回值:

  • GAP_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Sending request operation is successful.

  • Others -- Sending request operation is failed.

返回:

The result of sending request.

T_GAP_CAUSE cig_mgr_acceptor_reject_cis(uint16_t cis_conn_handle, uint8_t reason)

Reject the request for the CIS.

If sending request operation is successful, the result of rejecting request for the CIS will be returned by the callback function registered by ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR with msg type MSG_CIG_MGR_REJECT_CIS_INFO.

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
    T_GAP_CAUSE cause = cig_mgr_acceptor_reject_cis(cis_conn_handle, reason);
}

T_APP_RESULT app_isoc_cis_acceptor_cb(uint8_t cb_type, void *p_cb_data)
{
    T_APP_RESULT result = APP_RESULT_SUCCESS;
    T_CIG_MGR_CB_DATA *p_data = (T_CIG_MGR_CB_DATA *)p_cb_data;

    .......
    switch (cb_type)
    {
    case MSG_CIG_MGR_CIS_REQUEST_IND:
        {
            result = APP_RESULT_PENDING;
            APP_PRINT_INFO4("MSG_CIG_MGR_CIS_REQUEST_IND: conn_id %d, cis_conn_handle 0x%x, cig_id 0x%x, cis_id 0x%x",
                            p_data->p_cig_mgr_cis_request_ind->conn_id,
                            p_data->p_cig_mgr_cis_request_ind->cis_conn_handle,
                            p_data->p_cig_mgr_cis_request_ind->cig_id,
                            p_data->p_cig_mgr_cis_request_ind->cis_id);
        }
        break;

    case MSG_CIG_MGR_REJECT_CIS_INFO:
        {
            APP_PRINT_INFO5("MSG_CIG_MGR_REJECT_CIS_INFO: cause 0x%x, conn_id %d, cis_conn_handle 0x%x, cig_id 0x%x, cis_id 0x%x",
                            p_data->p_cig_mgr_reject_cis_info->cause,
                            p_data->p_cig_mgr_reject_cis_info->conn_id,
                            p_data->p_cig_mgr_reject_cis_info->cis_conn_handle,
                            p_data->p_cig_mgr_reject_cis_info->cig_id,
                            p_data->p_cig_mgr_reject_cis_info->cis_id);
        }
        break;
    ......
}

备注

This function is only used after return value of MSG_CIG_MGR_CIS_REQUEST_IND by application is APP_RESULT_PENDING for ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR.

参数:

  • cis_conn_handle -- [in] Connection handle of the CIS.

  • reason -- [in] Reason the CIS request was rejected. Value is Bluetooth HCI Error Code (except HCI_SUCCESS).

返回值:

  • GAP_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Sending request operation is successful.

  • Others -- Sending request operation is failed.

返回:

The result of sending request.

T_GAP_CAUSE cig_mgr_acceptor_config_sdu_param(uint16_t cis_conn_handle, bool acceptor_config_sdu_flag, uint32_t sdu_interval_m_s, uint32_t sdu_interval_s_m, uint16_t max_sdu_m_s, uint16_t max_sdu_s_m)

Whether to check SDU length when ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR calls gap_iso_send_data.

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
    T_GAP_CAUSE cause = cig_mgr_acceptor_config_sdu_param(cis_conn_handle, acceptor_config_sdu_flag, sdu_interval_m_s, sdu_interval_s_m, max_sdu_m_s, max_sdu_s_m);
}

备注

This function is used for ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR.

参数:

  • cis_conn_handle -- [in] Connection handle of the CIS.

  • acceptor_config_sdu_flag -- [in] Whether to check SDU length when ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR calls gap_iso_send_data. Whether to configure SDU parameters supplied by the relevant profile(s) for ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR.

    • true: SDU parameters listed below are configured by application. Check SDU length when ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR calls gap_iso_send_data.

    • false: Default value. SDU parameters listed below are not configured by application. Do not check SDU length when ISOCH_ROLE_ACCEPTOR calls gap_iso_send_data.

  • sdu_interval_m_s -- [in] The interval, in microseconds, between the start of consecutive SDUs from the Central's Host for all the CISes in the CIG.

    • Range: 0x0000FF to 0x0FFFFF.

  • sdu_interval_s_m -- [in] The interval, in microseconds, between the start of consecutive SDUs from the Peripheral's Host for all the CISes in the CIG.

    • Range: 0x0000FF to 0x0FFFFF.

  • max_sdu_m_s -- [in] Maximum size, in octets, of the payload from the Central's Host.

  • max_sdu_s_m -- [in] Maximum size, in octets, of the payload from the Peripheral's Host.

返回值:

  • GAP_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Operation success.

  • Others -- Operation failure.

返回:

Operation result.
